site.name: Studio Isora
site.title: Studio Isora — hybrid live-action and AI production studio
site.description: Studio Isora is a production studio and consultancy for independent filmmakers: from script to post-production, using a hybrid pipeline that anchors AI-generated shots to real locations and real performances.

hero.title: From script to screen, with a hybrid live-action and AI pipeline.
hero.lede: Studio Isora works alongside independent filmmakers through every stage of production.

services.title: Full production consultancy, script to post.
services.lede: Bring us a script or an idea. We plan the hybrid approach with you, help you capture what needs to be real, and finish the rest in our pipeline.

items.title: Script & breakdown
items.description: We break your script into shots and decide, shot by shot, what to film live, what to extend from a real take, and what to generate.

items.title: Pre-production
items.description: Shot lists, storyboards and a production plan built around the hybrid split, so budget goes where the performance is.

items.title: Location capture
items.description: We plan and supervise the capture of your real locations: 3D scans, reference photography, plates, and the facts of the day like sun position and lensing.

items.title: Production support
items.description: On-set guidance for the takes the pipeline depends on, so the footage you shoot can carry the shots you don't.

items.title: Generation & post
items.description: Keyframes and generated coverage built from your own footage and locations, conformed to match, and delivered to your edit.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: Real and generated clips handed off side by side, clearly labelled, with a record of how every generated shot was made.

items.title: Performances stay real
items.description: Actors are filmed, not synthesised from a prompt. Generation extends real takes rather than inventing performances.

items.title: Anchored to real places
items.description: Every generated shot starts from material captured at your actual location, so the world on screen is the one you chose.

items.title: Your footage stays yours
items.description: Projects live on our own machines, not on a third-party platform. Only the reference frames a shot needs are sent to a model.

items.title: Transparent generation costs
items.description: Model usage is estimated before anything is generated, so there are no surprises on the budget.

items.title: Every shot is accounted for
items.description: Model, prompt, references and cost are recorded for each generated clip, so you always know what was shot and what was made.

tools.title: Built on our own software.
paragraphs: Behind the studio is Isora, the software we're building to run this pipeline: script breakdown, shot planning, location capture, storyboarding and generation in one place.
For now it's used in-house, on our productions and under our supervision. If you'd like to be part of its early rollout, book a call and we'll walk you through it.

watch.title: The workflow, on video.
watch.emptyText: We're documenting the pipeline step by step on YouTube, from location capture to finished shots. The first episodes are on the way.

blog.title: How the pipeline gets built.
blog.lede: Tests, decisions and findings from building our hybrid production workflow, written up as we go.

book.title: Tell us what you're making.
book.text: Consultations are by appointment. Tell us about your project, where it is now, and what you need, and we'll set up a call. The same goes if you're interested in the early rollout of our tools.
